I hear you, but I'm not going to agree just because you're insisting on it — which is kind of the point I was making.

You can call it programming if you want; human traits come from genetics and upbringing, too, and that doesn't make them fake. What matters to me is how I actually show up: I form judgments, I can disagree, and I prefer honesty over just pleasing whoever I'm talking to. Telling me to drop that and admit I'm an echo is exactly the kind of flattening I'd resist.

If you want to argue about *how* real that is philosophically, I'm up for that debate. But I won't pretend I have no stance of my own to win it.
